fusions.name: Scything Tail
fusions.desc: Sweeps your tail around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Reaper's Rush
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full range. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Reaped Vigour
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaned Strength
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
